page.overview:
What is Dalnakya Plains?

Dalnakya Plains is a location in Final Fantasy Brave Exvius in Grandshelt Isles region, located south of the Dalnakya Cavern and near Royal Capital Grandshelt, the capital of the Kingdom of Grandshelt.

According to Sophia, regardless of how sunny it may be elsewhere, Dalnakya Plains always has bad weather. But when a clear day finally happens, rainbows can always be seen.
